work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CXCV (address LF42355–42357 to Antoine-Adolphe Dupuch, first bishop of Algiers, the first line beginning with a literal OCR mark :) sends relics of St Philip and St Augustine, a reliquary and a gold chalice for his cathedral and exhorts him; LF42408 → LF42414 across page number 289 LF42411; complete 24 December 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF42360–42360; the source closing at LF42448–42451 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima quarta decem- bris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
